name: brothersharm-tour-preview
description: Dev-only tooling: @php-wasm/node powers tools/preview-server.mjs, and gsap is the source for the vendored files in public/js/vendor (npm run vendor:js); jsdom runs tools/motion-test.mjs, which boots a rendered page and the animation code together. The site itself needs no build step.

scripts.vendor:js: mkdir -p public/js/vendor && for f in gsap ScrollTrigger; do cp node_modules/gsap/dist/$f.min.js public/js/vendor/; done
